title: Seattle Lake Union Private Boat Cruise To Lake Washington BYOB
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the beauty of Lake Union and Lake Washington from the comfort of your very own private luxury lake boat.

Pass by Gas Works Park and the many floating homes along the shore, including the iconic Sleepless In Seattle home.

Cruise through the Montlake cut into Lake Washington, passing by Husky Stadium and the boat house made famous in the movie 'Boys In The Boat.'

Take in views of Mount Rainier and the many mansions along the shores of Medina, including the Bill Gates Estate.

Finally, return to Lake Union for one last look at the Seattle skyline and its iconic Space Needle.

Optional stops include Downtown Kirkland, Old Bellevue, and Fisherman's Terminal near the Ballard Locks. Each stop provides guests with access to a variety of restaurants and boutique shops to enhance your experience in the Pacific Northwest.

Feel free to bring your own snacks and beverages. We have a cooler on board to keep things cold and plenty of seating to relax and enjoy the ride.
